crossRefs.note: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister…
however the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron…
Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for Yahweh’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million…

translations.web: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
translations.bsb: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.
translations.kjv: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
translations.asv: Iron is taken out of the earth, And copper is molten out of the stone.
